description: One-line tool descriptions, to measure what the shipped guidance earns.

tools.list: List concepts under a prefix, with counts per type.
tools.search: Keyword search over concepts. Returns ranked paths and titles.
tools.grep: Regex search over concept text. Returns paths and snippets.
tools.read: Read one concept: body, frontmatter, links and backlinks.
tools.create: Create a concept at a new path.
tools.relate: Add a link from one concept to another.
